headline: Q2 organic growth accelerated to 3% (4% ex-Middle East) as the US sped up and Fashion & Leather Goods returned to growth.
guidance_note: Remains confident for 2026 in an uncertain environment; no numeric guidance.
key_messages: Fashion & Leather Goods +1% organic in Q2 (first rise in two years) with rapid US acceleration; -1% for H1.
Wines & Spirits +5% organic in H1 (champagne +7%, cognac +3%); US cognac demand still soft.
Selective Retailing +6% organic in Q2 (+5% H1) led by Sephora; Watches & Jewelry +11% in Q2.
H1 revenue EUR 38.6B (-3% reported, +2% organic); recurring operating profit EUR 8.7B; US ~25% of revenue.

consumer.big_ticket: US growth accelerated across fashion and jewelry; Middle East conflict cost ~1 pt of growth.

macro_read: US luxury demand picked up in spring 2026, consistent with wealthy households benefiting from asset prices.
notes: LVMH is listed in Paris and reports in euros. It does not file with the SEC, so this card is refreshed on request, not automatically.
Revenue shown is Q2 2026 (EUR 19.52B); H1 was EUR 38.6B. Revenue growth of 0% reflects a secondary source calling reported revenue flat.
US +6% (Q2) from secondary sources only; not in LVMH's release text.
Released after Paris close; next-day share move not found.
